column1: # Round-2 evaluation sets (code_plan_2 §3.3, §6; DECISION D3, D4). One line per (set, condition). Fields separated by '|':
#   SET | TAG (= result dir name $RES/<model run>/<TAG>) | STEPS | SEED | extra generate_confs.py args ($VARS expanded)
# Oracle rule (SHORTLIST endpoints): any condition built from test-set GT L ends in _ORACLE.
# All seed-pickle conditions use --seed_confs_cycle (F3). Pickles: tools/make_l_seed_pickles.py -> $QM9_SEEDS2.
# --- S1 conditions. Sets (DECISION D3/D8 trimmed matrix, IMPLEMENTATION.md §6):
#   S1core  = 8 conditions (all but noise 0.01)          -> B1 x3, CR x3
#   S1panel = 6 conditions (no lam 0.25/0.75)            -> CB s0, B6 x3, S3 x2
#   S1panel4= 4 conditions (etkdg, mmff, noise .04, lam .5) -> B1cap
#   S1x     = noise 0.01 (D8 trim; only if the budget allows)
# --- S1.5 ring / acyclic oracles (CB, B1; CR only if packing passed: D3)
# --- CTRL_rematch extras: gtLcycle (GT-end F4 control + V18 anchor; vote_1 P2-a), lambda = 1.00 pipeline check (V18),
# V18 on B1 s0 too (its gtLcycle run exists from round 1)
# --- S4 (lambda-conditioned): lambda 0 on RDKit-type L, descriptive lambda grid on MMFF, lambda_in = lambda_build
#   S4core = lambda 0 on etkdg/mmff + lambda_in = lambda_build at 0 and 0.5; S4x = the descriptive rest (D8 trim)
# --- S5: B3 without --pre_mmff (train-only cell); B3 with --pre_mmff is its in-job default eval
# --- S6 sampler checks on the released model (3 sampling seeds) and on B1 s0 with gtLcycle (descriptive: D8 trims these first; not in the default matrix)
